# Contributing to thesis/exceptionally

`thesis/exceptionally` is developed in the monorepo [thesis-php/thesis](https://github.com/thesis-php/thesis),
in [`packages/exceptionally`](https://github.com/thesis-php/thesis/tree/main/packages/exceptionally), together with its tests and the other Thesis packages.
This repository is a read-only split: on every push to `main` of the monorepo, CI copies into it
what composer installs. Issues and pull requests are disabled here, and a commit made here would be lost
on the next split.

## Issues

Report a bug or propose a feature in the [issues of the monorepo](https://github.com/thesis-php/thesis/issues).
Name the package (`thesis/exceptionally`) and its version, and for a bug give the code that reproduces it,
what you expected and what happened instead.

## Pull requests

You need Git, Docker and Make: everything runs in containers, on the PHP version of the monorepo.

1. Fork [thesis-php/thesis](https://github.com/thesis-php/thesis) and clone your fork.
2. Install the dependencies: `make i`.
3. Change the code in `packages/exceptionally/src/` and its tests in `packages/exceptionally/tests/`.
   Every change is covered by a test.
4. Check the package while you work:
   - `make test P=exceptionally` runs its tests and starts the services they need,
   - `make phpstan P=exceptionally` runs static analysis,
   - `make fix P=exceptionally` applies Rector and the code style.
5. A change that users of the package can notice gets an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
   of `packages/exceptionally/CHANGELOG.md` ([Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/)).
   Leave the version headings alone: the maintainers release a version by adding one.
6. If you changed `packages/exceptionally/package.php` (dependencies, description, keywords),
   run `make sync` and commit the files it generates: CI fails on any difference.
7. Run `make check`, everything CI runs, and open a pull request to `main` of the monorepo.

The rules of the code and of the monorepo are in
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/thesis-php/thesis/blob/main/AGENTS.md) and the files it links.
